units.intent: Defines a single uninitialized global int pointer whose sole purpose is to be dereferenced out of bounds by TestPlugin's generatesegfault* commands, giving clustertest a reliable way to crash the server on demand.

objects.name: __pointerToFakeIntArray
objects.role: global int pointer, deliberately never allocated, read out of bounds to trigger a real segfault

misfits.why: a single global exists as its own .cpp file; its only direct user in this batch is TestPlugin.cpp (extern-declared there), and the file's own comment references BadCommandTest, which only references the associated command names, not the symbol itself

name_fit.note: names the mechanism (extern pointer), not the intent (crash trigger)

location_fit.note: fits alongside the plugin that uses it

naming_quality.note: double-underscore-prefixed identifier (__pointerToFakeIntArray) is a reserved-identifier violation at the language level, though the name is otherwise self-explanatory

units.intent: A BedrockPlugin loaded only by the cluster-test binary that exposes dozens of otherwise-unreachable server code paths (slow queries, deliberate crashes, HTTPS timeouts, escalation, prepare/commit hooks) as commands so clustertest can exercise them.

objects.name: TestHTTPSManager
objects.role: SHTTPSManager subclass for issuing/inspecting test HTTPS transactions, including a send that never writes to the socket for timeout testing

objects.name: BedrockPlugin_TestPlugin
objects.role: the test plugin itself; owns the HTTPS manager, a background unreplicated-delete thread, and lifecycle hooks (upgradeDatabase, stateChanged, onPrepareHandler, afterCommit)

objects.name: TestPluginCommand
objects.role: BedrockCommand subclass whose peek/process/postProcess dispatch on request.methodLine to drive each individual test scenario

objects.name: fileAppend
objects.role: file-local flock-guarded append helper used by the testescalate scenario to record ordering

objects.name: fileLockAndLoad
objects.role: file-local flock-guarded read helper paired with fileAppend

misfits.why: generic flock-guarded file I/O helpers with no relation to plugin/command logic, defined as plain global functions in a plugin .cpp
ad hoc static cross-command scratch storage that bypasses normal command/database plumbing entirely, held as globals for test convenience

name_fit.note: clearly a test plugin, matches file/dir

naming_quality.note: mostly consistent (BedrockPlugin_ prefix, _ on private members); arbitraryData/not_special are intentionally vague scratch names, and storeboradcasttimeouts is a typo baked into the command name
